lead.description: a choice among actions whose uncertain outcomes are scored by a utility or a loss

overview_sentence: A decision problem lists actions, scores their outcomes, and chooses by expected utility or expected loss.

self_checks.title: Radiotherapy score
self_checks.prompt: With cancer probability 0.9, life expectancies 16.7 and 34.8 months, and a one-month penalty, what is the radiotherapy score?

self_checks.title: No treatment
self_checks.prompt: With the same probability, cancer expectancy 5.6 months and non-cancer expectancy 34.8 months, and no penalty, what is the no-treatment score?

self_checks.title: Surgery at probability one half
self_checks.prompt: Cancer probability 0.5, surgery survival probability 0.65, cancer expectancy 20.3, non-cancer expectancy 34.8, and a one-month penalty inside the survivor branch. What is the surgery score?
self_checks.answer: The score is 17.2575 months, below radiotherapy at 24.75.
